drives.name: WenIsInMood
drives.description: Homemade Animes, Chinese, Japanese, Korean shows

drives.name: MajorGiant
drives.description: Broad catalog of mostly mid-budget live-action films from the 1960s through upcoming 2026 releases, weighted toward adult dramas: character studies, biographical and period dramas, legal/political and crime thrillers, war films, and romantic dramas, with comedies, occasional action, documentaries, and TV-movie/Hallmark-style romance mixed in.

drives.name: Bostafari
drives.description: Eclectic cinephile library: world arthouse & classic-cinema canon, Hong Kong/wuxia martial arts, anime & Ghibli, cult/grindhouse horror, plus British TV comedy and music/art/true-crime docs.

drives.name: Mario
drives.description: Eclectic, movie-heavy library with no single focus. Lots of horror (Stephen King & Asian horror), broad comedy (mainstream and auteur indie), arthouse/auteur cinema, sports dramas and true-crime, plus a little anime. Spans the 1980s to 2020s and includes freshness-based collection posters (newly/recently added).

drives.name: Wenisinmood(#2)
drives.description: Original Language Titled Posters — East Asian-focused companion library: mostly anime (long-running detective, shonen, sports and a lot of isekai, plus films), Chinese historical/palace drama, Korean drama and Hong Kong action, with a small French/Belgian dark-comedy element.

drives.name: Tarantula212
drives.description: Contemporary Indian library, almost entirely 2020s: Hindi/Bollywood plus South Indian (Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada) films and a large slate of OTT web series, heavy on crime, thriller, true-crime and political/historical drama.

drives.name: Solen
drives.description: Small, seasonal-leaning drive: mostly Hallmark-style Christmas/holiday TV movies, plus some Swedish reality and home/lifestyle TV and a bit of kids' animation.

drives.name: BerserkeR
drives.description: Large, movie-heavy cinephile library dominated by horror in every subgenre: elevated/arthouse, extreme/grindhouse, and deliberately trashy creature-feature schlock, over a serious auteur backbone of world-cinema classics. Strong crime/thriller, war, and true-crime/cult documentary, plus a Brazilian-cinema strand. Includes director/actor and A/V-format (Dolby Vision/Atmos) collection posters. Mostly 2000s to 2020s.

drives.name: Darkkazul
drives.description: Eclectic, movie-heavy library: American comedy (especially '80s to 2000s) and indie/arthouse film, a lot of documentaries (food & wine, music, and niche subjects), isekai-leaning anime, and mid-budget thrillers, with some classic and recent festival cinema.

drives.name: Confused
drives.description: Modern East Asian-focused library: mostly Korean drama (romance, fantasy & thriller) and Chinese xianxia/historical costume drama, plus a solid amount of anime. Almost entirely 2020s, with a few recent Western film/TV and kids' titles.

drives.name: Wenisinmood(#1)
drives.description: Eclectic mixed library with no single focus. Lots of anime (long-running detective, shonen, sports & isekai series plus films), East Asian film & TV (Korean drama, Chinese historical drama, Hong Kong action), classic Hollywood & Westerns, stand-up comedy specials, British comedy & panel TV, and documentaries (music, nature, true-crime & cult). Broad era range, weighted to the 1990s to 2010s.

drives.name: BZ
drives.description: Mostly-TV library centered on crime, mystery & detective drama: heavy on British 'cosy crime' and procedurals plus Nordic/European noir, thriller limited series, and Christie-style whodunits. Skews very recent (2010s to 2020s), plus a few prestige films, holiday romance TV movies, and lifestyle, travel & nature factual shows.

drives.name: LionCityGaming
drives.description: International cinephile movie collection (almost no TV): a deep world-cinema and classic/silent canon, an especially large Indian catalog (Bollywood & South Indian), Asian extreme & genre cinema, elevated/arthouse horror, and documentaries. Spans the 1900s to today.

drives.name: TokenMinal
drives.description: Predominantly an anime library: deep Studio Ghibli and Makoto Shinkai catalogs, classic and modern series, and a large isekai catalog, plus collection posters for broadcast seasons (Winter/Spring/Summer/Fall) and demographics (shounen/shoujo/seinen/josei). Also a secondary set of French & Québécois live-action film and TV, plus a few documentaries.

drives.name: Jpalenz77
drives.description: Small, eclectic collection: a handful of recent (2024 to 2025) indie films and prestige TV alongside music and true-crime documentaries, plus a couple of cinema classics.

drives.name: MiniMyself
drives.description: Modern genre-focused movie & TV library with a 2000s-2010s skew: especially deep in anime, mainstream/franchise horror, superhero & comic-book adaptations, and sci-fi/action, with R-rated comedies mixed in.

drives.name: Iamspartacus
drives.description: Large modern mainstream movie & TV library with a streaming-era skew: complete Hollywood franchises and prestige & premium-cable drama, plus an especially deep catalog of stand-up comedy specials, true-crime & documentary, and reality/competition TV, with classics and arthouse mixed in.

drives.name: Dweagle79
drives.description: Comprehensive mainstream movie & TV library: every major franchise (Marvel, DC, Star Wars/Trek, Alien), kids & family animation, blockbusters, comedies, prestige & reality TV, anime, docs and stand-up, spanning the 1920s to today. Extensive smart-collection art by decade, runtime, format (3D/4K/HDR/Atmos/Dolby Vision), studio & network, and genre.
